mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signal a supply-driven recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of regime instances, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of rising RSAFS periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1700 thousand units signals reduced residential investment that weakens economic activity and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1700, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) trend over the prior 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of declining INDPRO periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
